post.description: Issues a single-use grant for an Agent Builder preview of this Website Chat. Only callable from the 360 portal; the preview runs without allowed websites (also before any are added), is exempt from Website Chat analytics and ends after 15 minutes. The grant is exchanged at POST /v1/sessions within 60 seconds.

design_id.description: Unsaved design to preview. Omit to keep the saved design; null previews the default design.

demo_customer.description: Start the preview as a fictional, verified demo customer (no login, no sign-out). In-chat actions are simulated with demo data and write nothing; the Website Chat frame shows journeys as a simulated hand-off and never loads them.

post.description:
Creates a turn or replays its persisted result. Reuse request_id and the exact
payload for a retry. History, org, agent, tools and account identity cannot be supplied.
TEMPORARILY_UNAVAILABLE means the request outcome could not be checked; retry the same request ID and payload.
A running request returns 409 IN_PROGRESS; a changed payload returns 409 REQUEST_CONFLICT.
A failed admitted request never starts another model execution when retried.

200.description:
SSE data frames whose JSON payload follows the PublicEvent component schema.
Only delta, action, complete and error events are public. Completion follows persistence.
